baseline_signal_register.rule_link_note: Links use the rule IDs and meanings in architecture_body.md. A linked rule applies only when its own prerequisites and condition are met.

signals.grain_units: One property; identifiers and match status
signals.processing: Normalise address; reconcile address/parcel links and aliases; require unambiguous entity before dependent joins.
signals.output: Confirmed identity or explicit ambiguity with candidate matches.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Withhold dependent findings; request address/plan confirmation.

signals.grain_units: Property and ownership scheme; category
signals.processing: Distinguish detached house, unit-title house and apartment; keep dwelling form separate from legal ownership.
signals.output: Correct applicable modules, including shared-property records when relevant.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Mark ownership form unresolved; do not assume detached appearance means standalone title.

signals.grain_units: Building polygon; metres and attribution status
signals.processing: Link the actual dwelling to its parcel; separate sheds, garages, roof outline and habitable footprint.
signals.output: Verified or qualified dwelling geometry for exposure checks.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Use parcel-level screening only and label building-level exposure unknown.

signals.grain_units: Boundary geometry; positional tolerance in metres
signals.processing: Compare mapping with authoritative plans; record positional uncertainty and resolve material mismatches.
signals.output: Boundary confidence and need for survey review.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not give exact boundary-distance conclusions without adequate geometry.

signals.grain_units: Parcel/building; intersection area m² and proportion %
signals.processing: Intersect valid geometry under the documented CRS; distinguish positive-area overlap, boundary touch, non-overlap and indeterminate alignment; report parcel and dwelling findings separately.
signals.output: Mapped exposure to the stated event, without claiming damage probability.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: If model coverage or identity is uncertain, report not assessed rather than no flood risk.

signals.grain_units: Boundary relation; distance/tolerance metres
signals.processing: Assess whether mapping uncertainty could change the intersection result; use evidence-based tolerances.
signals.output: Boundary-sensitive finding requiring more precise evidence.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Withhold definitive inside/outside conclusion where tolerance is unknown or material.

raw_inputs: Numerical flood model or specialist report
signals.grain_units: Dwelling/location; metres only with numeric evidence
signals.processing: Use validated numerical data or a scoped report; never convert map tile colours into exact depths.
signals.output: Documented depth/range or map-only context.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Keep depth unknown until numerical model/report and datum are available.

signals.grain_units: Property/component; categorical findings and repair evidence
signals.processing: Extract observed drainage defects and scope; distinguish stormwater/overland flow from mapped river flooding.
signals.output: Drainage issue, affected areas and next inspection or repair step.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No riverine map intersection does not clear drainage risk; request inspection.

signals.grain_units: Parcel/nearby terrain; slope degrees and elevation metres
signals.processing: Derive terrain context at supported resolution; check age and alterations; do not infer water depth.
signals.output: Potential drainage investigation trigger with terrain limitations.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Mark terrain analysis unavailable or stale; no invented flow path.

signals.grain_units: Dwelling; vertical difference metres
signals.processing: Calculate clearance only where level definitions, datum and event align.
signals.output: Evidence-backed floor clearance/range for the specified scenario.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Withhold calculation if either level or datum is missing; ground elevation is insufficient.

signals.grain_units: Parcel; mapped category and intersection
signals.processing: Intersect the correct designation layer and retain its category/date; boundary-only or uncertain alignment creates a review gap rather than a definitive designation finding.
signals.output: Official designation requiring building and insurance follow-up.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Missing layer/coverage is not absence of fire exposure.

signals.grain_units: Property/building; assessment category and observed measures
signals.processing: Separate official area designation from site-specific assessment and mitigation evidence.
signals.output: Verified resilience limitations and required specialist checks.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not derive BAL or loss probability from the area map alone.

signals.grain_units: Site/structure; qualitative finding and documented measurements
signals.processing: Extract verified soil/ground findings and their scope; link structural observations without diagnosing from imagery.
signals.output: Ground/retaining risk requiring specialist assessment or quoted remedy.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unknown without suitable report; slope or nearby cracks alone do not establish subsidence.

signals.grain_units: Site/parcel; status and dated obligations
signals.processing: Reconcile parcel aliases and current/historical records; preserve remediation conditions.
signals.output: Known contamination/history, restrictions and unresolved search gaps.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No register match does not clear contamination; request formal search where material.

signals.signal_name: Loose-fill asbestos history and other asbestos evidence
signals.grain_units: Property/material; known history and inspection scope
signals.processing: Match current and historical addresses; retain deregistered history; keep other asbestos assessment separate.
signals.output: Known loose-fill history and independent material-assessment status.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Negative register match does not prove no asbestos or no undiscovered loose fill.

signals.signal_name: Future heat, rainfall and fire-weather context
signals.grain_units: Regional grid; native units and scenario period
signals.processing: Summarise model scenarios and ensemble range at supported geography; align horizon with buyer holding period.
signals.output: Conditional regional climate context, separate from measured current hazards.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: If access/model metadata is missing, keep future quantitative claims unavailable.

signals.signal_name: Title or lease conflict with intended use
signals.grain_units: Property/title; verified restriction and buyer requirement
signals.processing: Extract restrictions with source pages; compare with explicit intended use; flag for professional interpretation.
signals.output: Documented buyer-use conflict or unresolved legal question.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No title/lease means legal fit incomplete; do not clear intended use.

signals.grain_units: Parcel/instrument; category and extent where verified
signals.processing: Link registered instruments to affected land and intended works without inventing easement geometry.
signals.output: Material building/access constraint and verification action.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unknown scope stays unresolved until instrument/plan review.

signals.signal_name: Current zoning and statutory development controls
signals.grain_units: Parcel/policy; current and applicable legal version
signals.processing: Combine spatial zone with legal provisions; distinguish current entitlement from proposed change.
signals.output: Supported development constraints or requirement conflict.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Map zone alone cannot establish permission; hold conclusion when legal controls are absent.

signals.grain_units: Building/alteration; approved versus observed status
signals.processing: Compare authorised documents with observed built form; treat discrepancies as verification triggers.
signals.output: Potential unapproved work or missing completion evidence.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Absence of a retrieved plan is not proof of illegal work; request records.

signals.grain_units: Building/component; documented defect severity
signals.processing: Extract actual findings with page references and inspector qualifications; preserve inaccessible areas.
signals.output: Material defect, uncertainty and scoped follow-up.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No inspection or inaccessible component remains not assessed.

signals.grain_units: Component; observed defect and date
signals.processing: Separate observed moisture from suspected causes; retain test limits and repair evidence.
signals.output: Water-ingress finding and investigation/repair need.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Photos alone cannot clear concealed damage; request targeted inspection.

signals.grain_units: Building/site; activity/history and assessment scope
signals.processing: Extract current activity, damage and prevention evidence without treating past treatment as clearance.
signals.output: Pest concern and further assessment or maintenance need.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Missing/incomplete inspection means pest condition unknown.

signals.grain_units: Property/component; AUD range and timing
signals.processing: Separate urgent repairs from lifecycle maintenance; use documented quotations or labelled estimates and avoid duplicate work items.
signals.output: Upfront/near-term cost range and unresolved cost exposure.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unpriced material defects remain material uncertainty; do not enter zero cost.

signals.grain_units: Quote/property; coverage categories and expiry
signals.processing: Compare reviewed policy terms with buyer requirements; distinguish one refusal from market-wide insurability.
signals.output: Cover conflict, suitable reviewed offer or evidence gap within stated quote scope.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Insurability unknown without current suitable evidence; never infer from hazard map alone.

signals.grain_units: Quote; AUD/year and AUD excess
signals.processing: Compare only materially similar cover/input combinations; retain quote validity and unpriced exclusions.
signals.output: Annual ownership-cost input and conditional premium comparison.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No generic suburb premium substituted for actual quote; show missing cost.

signals.grain_units: Property/policy; AUD amounts and documented ratio
signals.processing: Compare like-for-like rebuild scope; keep land value and market price out of rebuild-cost basis.
signals.output: Possible underinsurance and coverage-scope gaps.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No rebuild estimate means adequacy unknown; sale price is not a replacement.

signals.grain_units: Scheme/unit; documented issue and liability basis
signals.processing: Activate for applicable shared-title houses/units; link shared defects to unit exposure without assuming liability amounts.
signals.output: Shared-building issue and document/professional review need.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Missing required scheme records means assessment incomplete, even if detached-house appearance.

signals.grain_units: Scheme/unit; AUD balances, levies and dated commitments
signals.processing: Compare planned works with funds and documented obligations; distinguish current levy from adequate future funding.
signals.output: Known special levy/cash requirement and unfunded-work concern.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Low levies alone are not positive evidence; unresolved funding stays unknown.

signals.grain_units: Canonical project/stage; status, distance and direction
signals.processing: Deduplicate application versions; match relevant land and actual proposal scope; separate approved from constructed.
signals.output: Nearby development fact with status and affected buyer interests.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No retrieved DA does not establish no future or exempt development.

signals.signal_name: Potential sunlight, outlook and privacy change
signals.grain_units: Dwelling/proposal; qualitative impact or verified hours/geometry
signals.processing: Use verified geometry/modelling where available; flag a relevant northern proposal without inventing lost sunlight hours.
signals.output: Amenity finding with modelled versus unverified effects separated.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Keep daylight/privacy impact unresolved if geometry, orientation or plan quality is insufficient.

signals.grain_units: Amendment/site; lifecycle and effective date
signals.processing: Link draft and final instruments; distinguish consultation, interim effect, approval and commencement.
signals.output: Upcoming/current control change and relevance to property.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not apply proposed permissions as current law; unresolved status labelled.

signals.grain_units: Site/precinct/district; indicative year and yield
signals.processing: Identify nearby prospective change; compare annual plans for deferrals and scope revisions.
signals.output: Longer-term growth context with indicative status.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unmapped/uncertain proposals remain regional context; no promised delivery.

signals.grain_units: Project/stage; separate milestone states and date ranges
signals.processing: Maintain parallel lifecycle dimensions; link aliases and superseded notices; detect deferral/cancellation.
signals.output: Evidence-backed delivery status and timing uncertainty.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Missing milestone evidence remains unknown; announcement is not commitment or completion.

signals.grain_units: Buyer journey/project; minutes only with suitable route/service inputs
signals.processing: Compare usable access/travel scenarios using documented assumptions; account for barriers, transfers and horizon.
signals.output: Conditional opportunity linked to buyer use, without price uplift or risk offset.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: If routing or service assumptions lack support, describe qualitative potential only.

signals.signal_name: Construction disruption and operating amenity impacts
signals.grain_units: Property/route/project; duration and documented effect
signals.processing: Separate temporary works from ongoing operation; cite relevant plans and evidence scope.
signals.output: Disruption timeline and documented amenity/access issue.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not invent noise levels or traffic counts from distance alone.

signals.grain_units: Comparable segment/area/horizon; net dwellings by stage
signals.processing: Link repeated project records; subtract known removals; report proposed/approved/commenced/completed separately.
signals.output: Conditional competing-supply scenario with coverage and timing uncertainty.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unverified completion remains unverified; no double counting or oversupply declaration.

signals.grain_units: SA2/segment; approvals per 100 comparable dwellings over stated period
signals.processing: Align boundaries/type/time; use rolling totals and label stock age; do not treat approvals as delivery.
signals.output: Recent approval pressure relative to appropriate stock.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Suppress ratio when denominator/type match is inadequate; show raw contextual counts.

signals.grain_units: ACT or supported region; dwellings, months and published rates
signals.processing: Assess regional pipeline progression using actual series definitions and revisions.
signals.output: Regional delivery context informing scenario ranges.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No suburb completion estimates fabricated from ACT totals.

signals.signal_name: Evidence for scarcity versus low turnover
signals.grain_units: Comparable market; stock, listings and turnover over explicit period
signals.processing: Distinguish structural constraints, few listings and low transaction activity; assess nearby substitutes.
signals.output: Supported scarcity factors and counter-evidence, without automatic growth claim.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not declare shortage when current listings, demand or stock coverage is absent.

signals.grain_units: SA2/region; people and annual percentage change
signals.processing: Use consistent boundaries and multi-year change; retain preliminary/revised status and observation age.
signals.output: Regional demand context, not a property-price forecast.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not present annual lagged population as current-month observation.

signals.grain_units: Supported region/scenario; households over horizon
signals.processing: Compare future population divided by assumed household size with baseline; retain scenario source and uncertainty.
signals.output: Conditional household-demand range aligned with supply horizon.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not downscale regional projections to suburbs without an explicit validated method.

signals.grain_units: SA2/ACT and buyer context; % and category
signals.processing: Separate modelled local unemployment from observed regional employment; use smoothed/year-on-year context and concentration.
signals.output: Employment-related demand/resilience context at true data geography.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not derive employment from SALM or treat local industry mix as individual income certainty.

signals.grain_units: Comparable sale/property; AUD and evidence age
signals.processing: Select comparable settled sales with explicit exclusions, differences and sample size; verify rights/access first.
signals.output: Comparable set and evidence quality for valuation review.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Documentation-only API access supplies no prices; missing transactions means valuation unavailable.

signals.grain_units: Property; AUD range and relative position
signals.processing: Use a transparent supported comparison range; avoid treating asking price or model estimate as ground truth.
signals.output: Price position and material uncertainty, not guaranteed fair value.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Withhold precise premium/discount if comparables or adjustments are inadequate.

signals.grain_units: Comparable market; turnover, count and supported marketing durations
signals.processing: Measure turnover on matching geography/type; use time-on-market only from genuine listing observations.
signals.output: Resale liquidity context with sample size and data limits.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Sale dates alone do not establish time-on-market; no hidden listing API assumed.

signals.grain_units: Property versus ACT aggregate; AUD/week/month and period
signals.processing: Keep property evidence separate from regional bond context; calculate net rental scenarios only with declared costs.
signals.output: Supported rent range/context and conditional net-income scenario.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: ACT aggregates do not prove suburb/property rent or vacancy; missing property evidence stays unknown.

signals.grain_units: Suburb/region; counts and rates with denominator/year
signals.processing: Use multi-period trends, small-count caution and commercial/residential context; preserve revisions.
signals.output: Neighbourhood offence context without address-level victimisation probability.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Stale/missing crime data is unknown, not zero; suppress unstable unsupported rate claims.

signals.grain_units: Property/school/year; eligibility category
signals.processing: Check address and year against official PEA; record shared-zone caveats and announced changes.
signals.output: Eligible-school evidence and requirement fit.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not infer eligibility from proximity or guarantee preferred school in a shared zone.

signals.grain_units: Journey/time period; services/hour and supported travel minutes
signals.processing: Assess scheduled usefulness for relevant days/times; keep walking-network and reliability evidence separate.
signals.output: Usable-service profile and commute/access constraints.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Without approved feed/routing access use dated timetable/manual evidence; no invented travel times.

signals.grain_units: Road/intersection/route; reported counts and spatial relation
signals.processing: Aggregate appropriate multi-year observations near actual access routes; flag approximate points and exposure limits.
signals.output: Route-related investigation prompt, not personal collision probability.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No crash/traffic exposure data means context incomplete; distance alone cannot quantify risk.

signals.grain_units: Dwelling; native rating scale and assessment date
signals.processing: Verify report/method; keep envelope, Whole of Home and actual bills distinct; assess currency.
signals.output: Supported energy/comfort evidence and upgrade questions.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Listing stars without source remain unverified; no conversion between incompatible scales.

signals.grain_units: Suburb/region or verified local context; canopy %
signals.processing: Retain actual survey vintage and height definition; distinguish area canopy from property shade.
signals.output: Dated canopy context and limited-shade investigation trigger.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not infer house temperatures, exact shade hours or young-tree absence from regional canopy.

signals.grain_units: Property/location/time; units only from actual assessment
signals.processing: Record measured and self-reported evidence separately; preserve sampling limits and source competence.
signals.output: Evidence-backed amenity concern or explicit measurement gap.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No verified public noise/air adapter in source set; do not infer levels from traffic, canopy or distance.

signals.signal_name: Macro rates and actual borrowing terms
signals.grain_units: National series and actual loan; annual % with dates
signals.processing: Show macro context separately from contractual buyer rate; retain product and fixation dates.
signals.output: Rate context and actual starting assumptions for cash-flow scenarios.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Cash target is not the buyer mortgage rate; no offer means declared scenario only.

signals.grain_units: Buyer/property; AUD/month
signals.processing: Calculate appropriate repayment schedule and complete monthly cash flow; keep assumptions visible and avoid counting principal twice.
signals.output: Baseline surplus/deficit with input completeness.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Incomplete costs/income cannot produce a definitive pass; record missing inputs.

raw_inputs: Scenario start and duration in months
signals.grain_units: Buyer/scenario; rate percentage points and AUD/month
signals.processing: Apply disclosed stress increments to relevant loan periods over the named duration; calculate monthly cash balances and assess any reserve breach within that horizon.
signals.output: Conditional resilience result, not a predicted interest-rate path.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: If loan terms or reserve policy are missing, withhold pass/fail and request values.

signals.grain_units: Buyer/scenario; AUD and months
signals.processing: Simulate declared duration/amount of income loss with accessible cash only; reflect fixed obligations.
signals.output: Time-to-reserve-breach and scenario trade-offs.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not assume redraw/credit is available cash without evidence; show incomplete scenario.

signals.grain_units: Property/buyer; AUD/month/year and one-off AUD
signals.processing: Separate recurring, upfront and contingent costs; align timing; exclude duplicate repair/levy entries.
signals.output: Transparent ownership-cost schedule feeding affordability.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unquoted material costs remain a range or unresolved gap, never zero.

signals.grain_units: Buyer/scenario/horizon; AUD equity and cash shortfall
signals.processing: Deferred from V0. A later exit module applies explicit price scenarios, calculates outstanding loan principal at sale from the repayment schedule and deducts sale/exit costs; no forecast probabilities are implied.
signals.output: Conditional exit shortfall; requires a separately specified future exit rule and explicit tax treatment.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Without balance/cost assumptions show incomplete; API documentation alone is not a valuation.

signals.grain_units: Every evidence item; dates and age
signals.processing: Evaluate freshness against native publication cadence and decision needs; separate old observation from recent retrieval.
signals.output: Fresh/current-for-purpose, stale or unverified status with dates.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unknown dates become an evidence gap; never label retrieved-today data current automatically.

signals.grain_units: Finding/domain; coverage categories and conflict status
signals.processing: Track supported versus uncovered questions; preserve conflicting evidence and superseded versions; review material disagreements.
signals.output: Assessment completeness and explicit unresolved contradictions.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not convert missing values to safe values or average contradictions into certainty.

signals.grain_units: Property/event; change type and timestamps
signals.processing: Distinguish real-world change, source correction and retrieval change; deduplicate repeated notices.
signals.output: Auditable alert stating what changed and which finding needs review.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: If previous snapshot/coverage is absent, identify first observation rather than a new event.

signals.grain_units: Buyer brief/version; categories and explicit thresholds
signals.processing: Capture declared requirements and apply relevant modules; keep subjective preferences separate from factual hazards.
signals.output: Personalised relevance, confirmed conflicts and outstanding buyer requirements.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not assume preferences or tolerances; use visible defaults only as unconfirmed scenario inputs.

raw_inputs: Confirmed applicable loan funds, conditions and dates
signals.grain_units: Purchase configuration and funding date; AUD
signals.processing: Sum price, known acquisition costs and committed immediate works; subtract confirmed applicable loan and purchase cash. Preserve separate reserve allocation and unconfirmed funding conditions.
signals.output: Confirmed funding gap or no gap within complete supported scope; provisional estimate where funding is not confirmed.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Missing costs or unconfirmed funds prevent a fully funded conclusion; create a funding-evidence gap.

baseline_signal_register.delivery_note: V0 core, V1 extended and V2 optional are design priorities, separate from implementation Stages0–6. Source availability is independently recorded. All rows are specifications, not live calculated values.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Address candidates; jurisdiction; property type; authoritative parcel/building/unit identifiers; geometry relationships; buyer-confirmed selection where ambiguous.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Every property assessment. NOT_APPLICABLE is not permitted for property identity.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: ASSESSED only when the selected property is resolved at the granularity needed by dependent checks. Multiple plausible units, unresolved parcel relations or conflicting identifiers fail this prerequisite.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Canonical identity and matched source identifiers, or preserved candidates and the exact unresolved relationship. Dependent conclusions cannot be attributed to an unconfirmed property.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 0 for resolved identity. Null substantive priority for an unresolved identity; investigate through the gap task.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: State NOT_ASSESSED; reason UNRESOLVED_PROPERTY_ID or CONFLICTED; substantive priority null; gap priority 3. Never transfer neighbouring-unit or building evidence silently.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Confirm the correct unit, parcel and building against authoritative records and the buyer's intended property, then rerun dependent checks.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: A shared address coordinate is not proof of shared title, dwelling condition or hazard exposure. This is a workflow policy, not a risk probability.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Source contract; acquisition result; schema/parser validation; field units; geographic and time coverage; permitted uses; check criticality; required-input manifest.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Every required source-dependent check. Missing access or evidence does not make the underlying check NOT_APPLICABLE.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: A dependent check can become ASSESSED only if acquisition or permitted retained evidence is usable, required fields and units validate, coverage includes the requested scope, and the intended use is authorised. An empty response is usable negative evidence only after these gates pass.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Explicit source-check outcome with coverage, query period, parser version, rights policy and rejected or quarantined fields.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 0 for a passed quality gate; null substantive priority when the gate fails. The gate does not itself assert a physical property hazard.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: State NOT_ASSESSED; reason MISSING_INPUT, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, OUTSIDE_COVERAGE, SCHEMA_INVALID, UNIT_UNKNOWN or LICENCE_NOT_AUTHORISED. Gap priority 3 for a critical check, 2 for another required check, 1 for an optional check.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Repair or replace the source path, resolve units/coverage/rights, or retain the visible limitation. Recalculate only the affected checks after valid evidence arrives.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: A publicly readable URL is not sufficient permission for every storage or display use. A successful HTTP request alone does not establish coverage or a negative property finding.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Source-specific freshness policy; effective/observation date; publication and retrieval dates; current-version or supersession evidence; quote/document expiry where applicable.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Every time-sensitive source or document. A historical assessment uses the applicable historical policy and available source version.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: Evidence passes when it meets its source-specific currency requirements and is not superseded for the assessed question. An old model publication date alone does not fail a map confirmed as the current official designation.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Source vintage, last currency check, applicable expiry/version and the reason it is current, historical-current, or stale for this use.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 0 when the currency gate passes; null substantive priority when it fails.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: State NOT_ASSESSED; reason STALE or PUBLICATION_TIME_UNKNOWN. Gap priority follows required-check criticality: 3 critical, 2 other required, 1 optional. A retained older result stays dated and cannot masquerade as a current result.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Obtain the current applicable version or explicitly limit the assessment/replay claim. Preserve previous versions and supersession history.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: Currency policy is explicit and source-specific. Polling an annual source daily does not create daily observations. Unknown publication time limits faithful historical replay.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Validated parcel/building/source geometries; coordinate reference systems; positional accuracy; relevant boundary relation; vertical datums if elevation comparison is requested.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Any check whose conclusion depends on geometry, distance, overlap or elevation. A vertical-datum gate applies only to analyses requiring vertical comparison.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: The spatial gate fails when invalid or insufficient geometry, unresolved coordinate systems, relevant positional uncertainty spanning the boundary, or incompatible vertical datums prevent the requested conclusion.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Separate parcel, dwelling and access relations; method and units; uncertain boundary zone; exact comparison that could not be completed.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 0 when the required spatial relation is sufficiently established; null substantive priority for the blocked conclusion. A boundary touch never silently becomes a clear result.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: State NOT_ASSESSED; reason INSUFFICIENT_SPATIAL_PRECISION, GEOMETRY_INVALID or DATUM_UNRESOLVED. Gap priority 3 for a critical consequence check, otherwise 2. Retain any narrower relation that is sufficiently assessed.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Obtain suitable geometry, survey/elevation information or an appropriate site assessment; rerun only the affected spatial checks.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: A point or parcel centroid is not a building footprint. A universal search radius is not an impact model. No distance or height conclusion is emitted in unknown units.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Resolved parcel; current applicable official flood-extent scenario; verified coverage; validated overlap relation with sufficient spatial precision; separate dwelling/access evidence where available; any reviewed resolution record.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Properties within the supported flood-screen jurisdiction and requested screening scope. Missing coverage is handled by FL02 and is not NOT_APPLICABLE.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: After identity, quality, currency and spatial gates pass, a positive parcel/flood-scenario overlap triggers mapped exposure. A boundary-only or uncertainty-spanning case is routed to GE01 instead of forcing inside/outside classification.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: The exact official scenario and mapped parcel relation, with dwelling, access and consequence assessment states kept separate. Retain the designation even if a later professional review resolves the investigation task.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 3 for unresolved positive overlap under the provisional due-diligence policy. 1 after appropriate current site/insurance evidence and an authorised review resolve the material questions; 0 for no overlap within fully assessed source scope. No unrelated flood mechanism is cleared.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Unusable required extent/identity evidence gives NOT_ASSESSED, null substantive priority and gap 3 with the applicable reason. Missing floor, drainage, access or insurance evidence leaves the supported overlap ASSESSED but creates separate consequence gaps, normally priority 3 when critical.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Obtain relevant dwelling-floor, drainage/access and insurance evidence; document specialist interpretation or mitigation and whether it resolves the specific buyer concern.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: An extent intersection is not a numeric depth, annual damage probability, expected loss or proof that the dwelling will flood. Closing a task does not erase the underlying map designation.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Required flood-mechanism checklist for the scope; source coverage geometries and periods; successful query evidence; scenario definitions; exclusions and current-version status.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Every required flood-screen mechanism, including separate river and overland-flow checks where required by the versioned catalogue.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: Coverage is insufficient when the source excludes the property, cannot be verified, is unavailable/stale, or does not address a required mechanism. A no-intersection result cannot pass without verified coverage.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Mechanism-by-mechanism coverage and explicitly unassessed mechanisms. A sufficiently assessed river result does not answer an overland-flow question.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 0 for a passed coverage gate; null substantive priority for an unassessed mechanism, with a separate investigation task.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: State NOT_ASSESSED; reason OUTSIDE_COVERAGE, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, STALE, MISSING_INPUT or UNSUPPORTED_METHOD as applicable; gap priority 3 for each critical required mechanism.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Identify a suitable source or obtain an appropriate site/drainage assessment. Keep the gap visible when no supported source can answer the question.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: No source record is not the same as no risk. The rule concerns evidence coverage and does not establish that an unmapped property is hazardous.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Resolved relevant land/building geometry; current applicable official bushfire designation; verified coverage and spatial precision; appropriate building/site/insurance evidence for any task resolution.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Required bushfire screening in a supported jurisdiction. An unavailable designation layer remains an evidence gap.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: After prerequisite gates pass, a positive overlap with the applicable official designation triggers a due-diligence action. An unresolved boundary relation routes to GE01.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Official category, version, location and property relation, with building vulnerability and insurance implications recorded as separate assessed or unassessed questions.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 3 for unresolved positive overlap under the provisional workflow; 1 after current appropriate site/building/insurance evidence and authorised review resolve the material task; 0 for no designation overlap in fully assessed scope.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Unusable designation evidence gives NOT_ASSESSED, null substantive priority and critical gap 3. Missing vulnerability or cost evidence does not erase a valid designation finding; it creates a separate gap.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Review applicable property/building implications and suitable insurance terms with appropriate evidence, then record any supported resolution.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: A designation is not a property-specific probability of fire, a forecast insurance premium or a conclusion about legal compliance. Site resolution does not remove an official designation.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Property-matched inspection or appropriately qualified assessment; inspection date and scope; defect description/materiality; exclusions; reviewed quotes/repair evidence where available; buyer requirements.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Building condition relevant to the proposed purchase and use. Hidden or uninspected components remain explicitly outside assessed scope.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: A validated inspection identifies a material defect or recommended material investigation. Priority 4 requires appropriate evidence of a present conflict with an essential intended-use requirement, not merely an uncertain repair estimate.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Observed defect and scope, required investigation/repair, evidenced cost or unknown cost, and any supported repair completion or specialist resolution.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 3 for an unresolved material defect or its material cost; 4 for a verified present essential-use conflict; 1 for a documented minor monitoring issue; 0 when no flag is identified in sufficiently inspected scope or a finding is validly resolved.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Missing/unsuitable inspection gives NOT_ASSESSED, reason MISSING_INPUT or INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE, null substantive priority and gap 3 for required building due diligence. Missing cost leaves an observed defect ASSESSED and creates a separate cost gap; no invented quote.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Obtain scoped specialist assessment and quotation or completion evidence; record whether the evidence actually resolves the specific defect and buyer consequence.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: Listing photos cannot establish the absence of concealed defects. A quote is not proof of completed repair. Costs remain ranges where scope is uncertain.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Property type and ownership structure; versioned required-document checklist; available inspections; relevant common-property, capital-works and levy records; document dates and authorised access scope.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Required building documents for every relevant property; strata/shared-liability checks only where that ownership relationship applies. Non-applicability needs an evidenced ownership reason.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: A required document/scope item is missing, unusable or excludes a required component; or appropriate records identify a dated special levy or capital-work liability applicable to the buyer case.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Document coverage, exclusions, confirmed buyer-relevant levies/works and explicitly unresolved liability amounts or timing.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 0 for complete reviewed scope without a flag; 2 for a known cost requiring an allowance; 3 for an unresolved material shared liability; 4 only when a verified current liability conflicts with a declared essential funding limit.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Missing required evidence gives NOT_ASSESSED with MISSING_INPUT, INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE, STALE or LICENCE_NOT_AUTHORISED; null substantive priority and gap 3 for critical items, 2 for other required items. Public-screen mode does not make documents irrelevant.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Obtain authorised missing records, clarify levy/work obligations and timing, and add supported costs once to the ownership scenario.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: A building's total liability is not automatically the individual buyer's share. Absence of a recorded levy does not prove absence of future capital works.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Resolved property/title identity; applicable authoritative title/lease/strata/planning instrument; exact buyer intended use and essential requirements; qualified interpretation where required; effective dates.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Each declared intended use or essential ownership requirement. A missing buyer plan or instrument is not grounds for treating a relevant check as NOT_APPLICABLE.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: Appropriate reviewed evidence establishes a current restriction that conflicts with a declared essential use. Ambiguous wording or conflicting instruments cannot establish the definitive conflict without resolution.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Exact restriction and source location, affected buyer requirement, effective period, reviewed interpretation and unresolved alternative or approval dependency.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 4 for a verified present essential-use conflict; 3 for a potentially material unresolved legal/use question; 2 for a relevant non-essential constraint; 0 when the specific reviewed requirement has no identified conflict.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Missing, ambiguous or conflicting required evidence gives NOT_ASSESSED with MISSING_INPUT, CONFLICTED or INTERPRETATION_REQUIRED; null substantive priority and gap 3 for an essential-use/title question, otherwise 2.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Obtain appropriate professional confirmation, evidence of permissible alternatives or a revised buyer plan; create a new assessment version after resolution.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: The engine does not certify legal compliance or invent approval rights. A contextual zoning label alone cannot settle a title, lease or permission question.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Current property-specific quote/policy terms; effective/expiry dates; declared buyer cover requirements; exclusions, excesses and insured limits; reviewed interpretation for ambiguous terms.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Any required assessment of insurance availability, affordability or suitability for the buyer's stated requirements.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: Reviewed quote terms fail a stated essential cover requirement, or a material exclusion/limit remains unresolved. The tested subject is the reviewed quote, not availability across the entire insurance market.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Quote-specific cover fit, exclusions, excesses, known premium and affected buyer requirement; record alternatives separately.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 4 for a verified present quote/essential-requirement conflict; 3 for material unresolved cover; 2 for a non-essential cost/term requiring review; 0 for an evidenced acceptable current quote within reviewed scope.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Missing, expired or materially ambiguous quote evidence gives NOT_ASSESSED with MISSING_INPUT, STALE or INTERPRETATION_REQUIRED; null substantive priority and gap 3 when insurance is a critical required check.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Clarify the terms or obtain suitable alternative quotes, then reassess the exact cover and budget requirements.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: One refusal or unsuitable quote does not prove general uninsurability. A quote does not guarantee future renewal terms or future claim payment.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Canonical project identity; source-backed milestones and plans; candidate geometry/use/height where available; property orientation and relationship; buyer amenity priorities and holding period.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Known nearby projects with a defensible potential relationship to sunlight, privacy, access, noise or competing supply. A generic radius alone retrieves candidates but does not establish impact.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: A relevant project and geometry/use relationship support a specific potential impact, while sufficient impact modelling or source documentation has not yet resolved it.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Project stage and version, supported relevance, affected buyer outcome, known timeline and the exact unverified impact question.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 2 for a supported potential amenity issue; 3 when a declared essential requirement could be materially affected and the critical impact evidence is unresolved; 1 for relevant context requiring monitoring only; 0 for no relevant candidate in a fully assessed search scope.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Missing register coverage or unusable project identity gives NOT_ASSESSED with OUTSIDE_COVERAGE, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or UNRESOLVED_PROJECT_ID. Missing essential impact inputs create a separate gap 3; other required impact gaps receive 2.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Obtain the applicable plans/conditions and suitable shadow, noise or access evidence; preserve revised/cancelled project versions and rerun the impact check.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: A proposal is not an approval, and approval is not completion. Northern location alone does not establish shadow loss; no price deduction is inferred from proximity.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Property-specific measurement or suitable validated impact model; proposed/as-built geometry and assumptions; project stage; declared buyer threshold and whether essential; relevant time window.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Only where a buyer or explicitly versioned review policy defines the amenity measure and threshold, and the available method can evaluate it.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: The supported measured/modelled amenity falls below the stated threshold or exceeds a stated maximum. Current measured effects and conditional future-project effects are classified separately.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Measure, units, threshold, method, assumptions, project state, assessed period and the exact buyer requirement breach.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 4 for a verified present measured conflict with an essential requirement; 3 for a supported conditional future breach of an essential requirement; 2 for a non-essential threshold breach; 0 for no breach in the adequately assessed scope.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Unsupported method, geometry or threshold gives NOT_ASSESSED with UNSUPPORTED_METHOD, INSUFFICIENT_SPATIAL_PRECISION or MISSING_INPUT; null substantive priority and gap 3 for an essential material question, otherwise 2.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Validate the impact with appropriate source plans or specialist evidence; review mitigation or revise the buyer requirement without overwriting historical findings.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: Thresholds are declared preferences or visible workflow policy, not universal valuation rules. A future impact remains conditional even when the model arithmetic is reliable.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Defined comparable dwelling segment and substitute market; canonical deduplicated developments; net dwelling additions by stage; source dates/coverage; horizon; demand context; any explicit review threshold.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: A market-context or resale/rental competition assessment with a declared relevant property segment and geography.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: One or more evidenced net competing additions exist in the relevant pipeline. Deduplicate land release, DA, approval and construction records by project. A higher review action requires breach of an explicit recorded competition threshold or a separately specified material buyer dependency.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Existing stock/listings separately from proposal, approval, commencement and completion counts; net additions; horizon scenarios; demand indicators and coverage limits.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 1 for an evidenced competing pipeline without a supported material threshold breach; 2 when a declared review threshold is exceeded; 0 only where the complete tested scope identifies no competing pipeline. No priority implies a price-loss probability.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Insufficient segmentation, deduplication, geographic coverage or stage evidence gives NOT_ASSESSED for the affected conclusion with MISSING_INPUT, OUTSIDE_COVERAGE or CONFLICTED; null substantive priority and gap 2, or 3 for an explicitly critical buyer dependency.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Reconcile project stages and net yields, obtain missing demand/completion evidence, and compare named low/base/high delivery scenarios without invented probabilities.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: Pipeline is not completed supply; population is not household formation; territory totals do not establish suburb completions. The rule does not independently establish oversupply or a future price fall.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Recorded offence category counts; complete comparable periods; geography and boundary version; valid denominator for rates; suppression/reporting caveats; any explicit buyer or review-policy threshold.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Area-level crime context where the category and geography are relevant to a declared buyer concern. No personal offending profile is produced.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: Report comparable category counts and, where justified, rates/trends. A threshold-based review action fires only when a recorded applicable threshold is exceeded on valid comparable data.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Counts, denominator and period; geographic resolution; rate/change where valid; small-count and reporting caveats; explicit threshold if one is used.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 2 for a valid breach of a declared review threshold; otherwise 1 for relevant contextual observations. 0 may describe no flag under the specific assessed policy but never no crime risk at the house.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Missing coverage, incompatible periods/boundaries or invalid denominator gives NOT_ASSESSED for the affected comparison with OUTSIDE_COVERAGE, PERIOD_MISMATCH, BOUNDARY_MISMATCH or DENOMINATOR_INVALID; null substantive priority and gap 2 for a required comparison.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Obtain comparable official data or retain counts and limitations; investigate location-specific concerns using appropriate evidence rather than demographic proxies.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: A suburb statistic is not an offence probability at the property. Small counts are not amplified into dramatic unsupported percentage conclusions. Protected demographic characteristics are not risk proxies.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Supported loan structure/repayment; net household income; precisely defined rental receipts where applicable; living and other debt costs; all required property costs; declared no-drawdown/reserve requirements; baseline horizon and cash schedule where needed.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Buyer financial assessment with sufficient budget inputs. A public screen without finances returns NOT_ASSESSED for affordability, not a reassuring financial score.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: Calculate baseline monthly surplus with every deduction applied once. A negative baseline surplus triggers review. It becomes a confirmed requirement conflict only if a declared essential no-drawdown requirement is violated, or the baseline cash schedule breaches an essential reserve within the specified horizon.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Repayment, income, itemised costs, surplus/deficit, horizon and reserve schedule; input sources, exclusions and the exact declared requirement affected.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 3 by default for a negative baseline surplus; 4 only for the verified essential no-drawdown/reserve conflict defined in the predicate. 0 for no baseline flag with complete inputs. Planned drawdown is not automatically a requirement conflict.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Missing budget/cost fields or unsupported loan structure gives NOT_ASSESSED with MISSING_INPUT or UNSUPPORTED_METHOD; null substantive priority and gap 3 for a required essential affordability check. A repayment-only calculation may still be displayed within its narrower scope.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Verify costs and loan assumptions, agree the relevant duration and drawdown tolerance, and revise the purchase/finance plan where a declared requirement is breached.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: A submitted budget is not loan approval. Tax treatment, daily lender interest, fees and supported loan structures are explicit. No rate or income forecast is implied.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Validated baseline inputs; named rate/income/vacancy/cost scenario; scenario duration in months; cash after settlement and committed upfront costs; protected reserve or minimum surplus target; buyer tolerance and essentiality; monthly schedule.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: A buyer-selected or clearly labelled policy scenario whose horizon and target are explicitly defined. No default occurrence probability is supplied.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: Simulate the specified duration. Fire when minimum cash balance within that duration falls below the protected reserve, or a stated scenario surplus target is breached. A negative surplus whose duration ends before reserve breach must not be reported as an observed reserve breach.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Scenario assumptions and duration, monthly cash schedule, minimum balance, time to reserve if reached, target breaches and source/calculator versions.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 3 when a named scenario required for purchase review breaches its declared reserve or surplus target; 2 for an optional exploratory scenario breach; 4 only when complete supported inputs establish conflict with an explicitly essential must-withstand requirement. 0 for no breach within the complete named scenario. Any priority 4 is a requirement conflict under the stated assumptions, not a forecast that the shock will occur.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Missing duration, target, cash or required cost inputs gives NOT_ASSESSED with MISSING_INPUT; null substantive priority and gap 3 for a required purchase-review scenario, otherwise 2. Do not assume an infinite stress duration.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Confirm assumptions and duration, examine revised finance/cost/reserve options, and show the resulting scenario difference without claiming the shock will occur.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: Cash after settlement cannot be reused as deposit or committed repair funding. Joint shocks are explicit. Priority reflects the declared review/essential requirement; it does not imply the scenario is likely. No expected loss is calculated by summing or probability-weighting uncalibrated scenarios.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Cash available after settlement and committed upfront costs; buyer-declared minimum cash amount or buffer-month threshold; threshold units and essentiality; complete monthly essential outgoings for a months-based metric.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Only where the buyer or a visible accepted policy defines the buffer metric and threshold. No threshold is invented from general advice.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: For an amount target, compare total remaining available cash with the declared minimum. For a months target, divide remaining cash by explicitly defined essential monthly outgoings and compare with the declared minimum months. Do not subtract the same protected amount before comparing it to itself.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Available cash, defined buffer metric, threshold, calculation and shortfall. Preserve whether the input is current or a proposed settlement configuration.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 4 for a sufficiently verified present/configuration breach of an essential buyer buffer requirement; 2 for a non-essential review threshold breach; 0 for a satisfied declared threshold with complete inputs.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Missing cash, threshold or required denominator gives NOT_ASSESSED with MISSING_INPUT or DENOMINATOR_INVALID; null substantive priority and gap 3 for an essential requirement, otherwise 2. Zero outgoings do not produce an infinite safety claim.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Verify committed cash uses and outgoings; alter allocated cash or the buyer's explicitly recorded requirement if appropriate, then create a revised assessment.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: Thresholds are buyer requirements or visible workflow policy, not universal financial suitability standards. The rule is distinct from FN02's time-varying stress resilience.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Proposed purchase price; known acquisition costs and committed immediate works; confirmed applicable loan funds; cash explicitly allocated to purchase; funding dates and conditions.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: Buyer assessments that evaluate whether the submitted purchase configuration is funded.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: Compute funding_gap = max(0, purchase price + known acquisition costs + committed immediate works - confirmed applicable loan funds - cash allocated to purchase). A positive gap on complete confirmed inputs is a present configuration conflict.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Itemised cash requirement, funding sources and conditions, gap amount and excluded or unknown costs. Preserve separate cash allocated to later reserves.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: 4 for a confirmed positive funding gap; 0 for no gap within a complete confirmed funding scope. Estimated or conditional unconfirmed finance cannot establish a fully funded conclusion.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Missing costs, uncertain cash allocation or unconfirmed loan availability gives NOT_ASSESSED with MISSING_INPUT or FUNDING_UNCONFIRMED; null substantive priority and gap 3. A provisional estimate can be shown but remains labelled provisional.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Confirm acquisition costs and loan/cash availability or revise the purchase configuration. Ensure cash is not simultaneously assigned to deposit, immediate work and emergency reserves.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: This checks the submitted funding configuration, not lending eligibility or a guarantee of settlement. Amounts and dates may require verification before a binding decision.

baseline_rule_register.required_inputs: Canonical project with source-backed milestones; supported route/service/amenity change; buyer destination or need; useful access evidence; expected time range, holding period, dependencies and adverse offsets.
baseline_rule_register.applicability: A project or delivered service has a defensible relationship to a buyer benefit. Straight-line proximity alone is insufficient to claim a walking-time improvement.
baseline_rule_register.predicate: Supported evidence identifies a specific useful benefit, its current/projected state and its relationship to the buyer's time horizon. Funding, approval, contracts and construction remain independent milestone facts.
baseline_rule_register.evidence_output: Separate opportunity card stating benefit, supporting milestones, timing, horizon fit, dependencies and noise/construction/supply offsets. Delivered amenities are labelled current; future benefits stay conditional.
baseline_rule_register.action_priority: Null in downside scoring: this is a separate opportunity result and never subtracts from assessed or gap priorities. Opportunity follow-up tasks may have their own explicit workflow ordering.
baseline_rule_register.gap_policy: Unsupported benefit/status/timing produces NOT_ASSESSED for that claim with MISSING_INPUT, CONFLICTED or UNSUPPORTED_METHOD. Use an opportunity follow-up priority 2, or a separate critical gap 3 if an essential buyer requirement explicitly depends on the unverified service.
baseline_rule_register.next_action: Verify the meaningful access/service benefit and delivery evidence; monitor specific milestones and recalculate if route, scope, timing or buyer needs change.
baseline_rule_register.limitations: No invented delivery probability, automatic price uplift or assumption that benefits are unpriced. A future service can coexist with substantial construction or permanent amenity costs.

security_contract.public_data: Only explicitly authorised reusable observations may enter shared property data.
security_contract.private_data: Tenant/case scope applies to inputs, derived signals, reports, caches and downloads.
security_contract.credential_policy: No credentials in catalogue or payload files; resolve through an authorised secret store during implementation.

findings.finding: Market-capacity modelling uses public project inputs, ABS housing data, private commercial data and industry research; geographic and time scope must remain explicit.
Pipeline revisions can reflect additions, removals, expenditure revisions and schedule shifts; monetary growth is not a dwelling count.
Material-price context can inform labelled sensitivities but cannot replace a property-specific quotation.
Infrastructure workforce constraints do not establish local housing displacement or a property-price effect.
The share of energy projects classified low/moderate schedule likelihood is not an individual-project delay probability.

capacity_report_reference.usage: Dated context and methodology reference; not a public raw-project API or a property score.
